name: Steam Turtle

items.name: Space
items.text: 80 feet long, 50 feet wide, 40 feet high

items.name: Sluggish
items.text: This vehicle must move twice its length for each 90-degree turn it makes.

items.name: Release Steam
items.text:
Frequency once per hour

---
Effect Two crew members each perform a 3-action activity on their turn to release a massive buildup of steam around the vehicle, dealing 11d6 fire damage to each creature in a 10-foot emanation (DC 35 basic Reflex save save). The release mechanism stops working if the vehicle is broken.

text: This heavily armored aquatic vehicle resembles a gargantuan sea turtle covered with steel plates. The steam turtle is designed for beach landings and assaults on port facilities. Once it disables enemy fortifications, it extends a long boarding gangplank for troops to disembark and deploy.
